translationRepairs: Liao Director of Astronomy Dao Kong Zhihe said: "Beneath it an extraordinary man shall be born, to accomplish unheard-of deeds—Heaven announces by signs what no human hand can make."
Liao Director of Astronomy Kong Zhihe said: "Beneath it an extraordinary man shall be born, to accomplish unheard-of deeds—Heaven announces by signs what no human hand can make."

Dao is a false surname from 到, and the name is 孔致和; but 到 does not stand as a verb of arrival before the name (that would be 孔致和到). The Taizu annal parallel is 司天孔致和 with no arrival. Drop Dao and do not insert arrived.
Liao Director of Astronomy Dao Kong Zhihe said: "Beneath it an extraordinary man shall be born, to accomplish unheard-of deeds—Heaven announces by signs what human effort cannot bring about."
Liao Director of Astronomy Kong Zhihe said: "Beneath it an extraordinary man shall be born, to accomplish unheard-of deeds—Heaven announces by signs what human effort cannot bring about."
The same 到 is not part of the personal name and is not a motion verb placed before 孔致和. Restore Kong Zhihe said, without arrived.
Shizong, Dading second year, intercalary second month, on xinmao: the sixteen spirit-tablets of Shendian Hall burned and the fire spread to Taihe and Houde halls.
Shizong, Dading second year, intercalary second month, on xinmao: the sixteen spirit-tablets of Shenlong Hall burned and the fire spread to Taihe and Houde halls.
神龍殿 is Shenlong Hall (divine-dragon hall). Shendian would require 神殿 and is a mistranslation of 龍.
Shizong, Dading second year, intercalary second month, on xinmao: the sixteen spirit-tablets of Shendian Hall burned, spreading to Taihe and Houde halls.
Shizong, Dading second year, intercalary second month, on xinmao: the sixteen spirit-tablets of Shenlong Hall burned, spreading to Taihe and Houde halls.
The literal likewise misreads 神龍殿 as Shendian; Shenlong Hall is the accurate name.
Eighth month, fifth month, on jiazi: at Bei Wangdian marsh a great wind; hail fell over ten li wide and sixty li long.
Eighth year, fifth month, on jiazi: at Bei Wangdian marsh a great wind; hail fell over ten li wide and sixty li long.
八月五月 as two months is impossible after 七年九月 and before a following 六月 then 十年正月. The date is the eighth year, fifth month (八年五月), which the idiomatic already uses.
In the twelfth month Mizhou presented one white crane and one white pheasant.
In the twelfth month Mizhou presented one white quail and one white pheasant.
白鶉 is a white quail; 鶴 would be required for crane. The replacement is accurate.
Twelfth month: Mizhou presented one white crane and one white pheasant.
Twelfth month: Mizhou presented one white quail and one white pheasant.
The literal repeats the crane error; 白鶉 is quail, paired with 白雉 pheasant.

In the second year of Taihe, eighth month, on bingshen, at the Stone Drum Mountain Sage Terrace in Wu’an County, Cizhou, ten great birds gathered on the terrace; their feathers shone in five colors, mostly red and yellow; ochre crest and chicken neck; tail broad and long like a carp’s tail and taller than a man; nine smaller young stood beside them, each four or five chi high.

In the second year of Taihe, eighth month, on bingshen, at the Stone Sage Terrace of Drum Mountain in Wu’an County, Cizhou, ten great birds gathered on the terrace; their feathers shone in five colors, mostly red and yellow; ochre crest and chicken neck; tail broad and long like a carp’s tail and taller than a man; nine smaller young stood beside them, each four or five chi high.
鼓山石聖台 is Drum Mountain plus Stone Sage Terrace; Stone Drum Mountain wrongly binds 石 to 鼓.

Taihe second year, eighth month, bingshen: at the Stone Drum Mountain Sage Terrace in Wu’an County, Cizhou, ten great birds gathered on the terrace; their feathers were brilliantly five-colored, mostly red and yellow; ochre crest and chicken neck; tail broad and long, shaped like a carp’s tail and tall enough to surpass a man; nine young somewhat smaller attended at the side, likewise four or five chi in height.

Taihe second year, eighth month, bingshen: at the Stone Sage Terrace of Drum Mountain in Wu’an County, Cizhou, ten great birds gathered on the terrace; their feathers were brilliantly five-colored, mostly red and yellow; ochre crest and chicken neck; tail broad and long, shaped like a carp’s tail and tall enough to surpass a man; nine young somewhat smaller attended at the side, likewise four or five chi in height.
The literal makes the same place-name error; Stone Sage Terrace of Drum Mountain matches 鼓山石聖台.
In Shao Wang's first Da'an year the Yellow River ran clear along the Xu–Pi border for more than five hundred li for nearly two years, and an edict proclaimed it throughout court and realm.
In King Shao of Wei's first Da'an year the Yellow River ran clear along the Xu–Pi border for more than five hundred li for nearly two years, and an edict proclaimed it throughout court and realm.
The Chinese title is 衛紹王, King Shao of Wei; Shao Wang omits 衛.
Shao Wang, Da'an year 1: along the Xu and Pi border the Yellow River ran clear for more than five hundred li, nearly two years; an edict on the matter was sent to court and realm.
King Shao of Wei, Da'an year 1: along the Xu and Pi border the Yellow River ran clear for more than five hundred li, nearly two years; an edict on the matter was sent to court and realm.
The literal likewise drops 衛 from 衛紹王; King Shao of Wei is the full title.
Chongqing 1, seventh month, at the wei hour before noon: wind from the east lifted a bolt of silk dozens of zhang high, coiled it like a dragon, and dropped it inside Gongchen Gate.
Chongqing 1, seventh month, on xinwei at the wei hour in the afternoon: wind from the east lifted a bolt of silk dozens of zhang high, coiled it like a dragon, and dropped it inside Gongchen Gate.
未時 is the early-afternoon double-hour, so before noon is wrong; the proposal still omits the day 辛未 that precedes 未時.
Chongqing year 1, seventh month, at the wei hour before noon: wind came from the east and blew a length of silk dozens of zhang high; it twisted like a dragon and fell inside Gongchen Gate.

Chongqing year 1, seventh month, on xinwei at the wei hour in the afternoon: wind came from the east and blew a length of silk dozens of zhang high; it twisted like a dragon and fell inside Gongchen Gate.
Correct the hour to afternoon, and restore the sexagenary day 辛未 still missing from the proposed literal.
Tenth month, on bingchen: northwestern mist piled like earthen ramparts and did not lift until the second watch.
Tenth month, on bingshen: northwestern mist piled like earthen ramparts and did not lift until the second watch.
丙申 is bingshen; bingchen would be 丙辰.
Tenth month, on bingchen, in the northwest mist like piled earth; it scattered only at the second watch.
Tenth month, on bingshen, in the northwest mist like piled earth; it scattered only at the second watch.
The literal repeats bingchen for 丙申; bingshen is required.
Second year, first month, at wuwu noon a thousand cranes wheeled above the palace court and did not leave for a full quarter-hour.
Second year, first month, at xinyou noon a thousand cranes wheeled above the palace court and did not leave for a full quarter-hour.
辛酉日午 is the day xinyou at noon; wuwu would be 戊午.
Second year, first month, at wuwu noon, more than a thousand cranes soared over the palace courtyard and departed only after a quarter-hour.
Second year, first month, at xinyou noon, more than a thousand cranes soared over the palace courtyard and departed only after a quarter-hour.
The literal has the same day error; 辛酉 is xinyou, not wuwu.
Aizong, Zhengda 1, first month, on wuwu: the emperor held his first audience, raising the empress dowager to Rensheng Palace and the Grand Consort to Cisheng Palace.

Aizong, Zhengda 1, first month, on wuwu: the emperor held his first audience, honoring the empress dowager as Empress Dowager of Rensheng Palace and the Grand Consort as Empress Dowager of Cisheng Palace.
尊太后為仁聖宮皇太后，太元妃為慈聖宮皇太后 confers palace-named empress-dowager titles; it does not move the women into those palaces.
